artifact_evidence.submitted_query: SELECT region, strftime('%Y-%m', '2023-01-01') AS month, SUM(amount) - SUM(refund_amount) AS net_revenue FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.cust_id JOIN returns ON orders.id = returns.order_id WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' GROUP BY region, month ORDER BY region, month LIMIT 1
